children: Happen, Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $263.2 million, down 1.2% from a year earlier, while net income increased 33.8% to $59.3 million and diluted EPS rose 35.1% to $0.5.
Revenue was $263.2M, compared with $266.2M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (1.2%).
Net income was $59.3M, compared with $44.3M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 33.8%.
Diluted EPS was $0.50, compared with $0.37 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 35.1%.
Loan originations grew 26% year over year to $3.34 billion, including 89% growth in loans held for investment.
Since January 2026, newly originated investment loans have used fair-value accounting, with origination fees and marketing costs recognized upfront.
LendingClub Corporation rebranded as Happen, Inc. on June 22, 2026, and its bank subsidiary became Happen Bank.
The company expects about $90 million in 2026 capital spending, mainly for digital marketplace bank development and office improvements.
